surfaces.name: Classic taskbar widget
surfaces.width: 42 + providers.count * (ceil(10 / max(1, providers.count)) * 11 - 1 + 4 + 62) + max(0, providers.count - 1) * 3 + (providers.opencode.enabled + providers.cursor.enabled) * 28

children.name: fleet-tray-two-dark
children.render: system.dark && data.poll_ok && fleet.available && fleet.headline.percentage < 90 && fleet.headline.percentage >= 9.5 && fleet.headline.percentage < 99.5

children.name: fleet-tray-two-light
children.render: (1 - system.dark) && data.poll_ok && fleet.available && fleet.headline.percentage < 90 && fleet.headline.percentage >= 9.5 && fleet.headline.percentage < 99.5

children.name: fleet-tray-two-critical-dark
children.render: system.dark && data.poll_ok && fleet.available && fleet.headline.percentage >= 90 && fleet.headline.percentage >= 9.5 && fleet.headline.percentage < 99.5

children.name: fleet-tray-two-critical-light
children.render: (1 - system.dark) && data.poll_ok && fleet.available && fleet.headline.percentage >= 90 && fleet.headline.percentage >= 9.5 && fleet.headline.percentage < 99.5
